# Mexican Train Dominoes

> Play Mexican Train Dominoes online for free — official rules, smart computer opponents, pass-and-play for 2-4 players, double-6 to double-15 domino sets, hints, undo, offline play. No download, no sign-up, mobile friendly.

The classic domino game in the browser: build your personal train and the shared Mexican Train from the engine double, cover every double, run out of tiles first, and score the fewest pips to win.

## Pages

- [Play Mexican Train Dominoes online (game)](https://mexicantraindominogame.com/): the free game plus quick rules and FAQs.
- [How to play Mexican Train Dominoes](https://mexicantraindominogame.com/how-to-play.html): complete official rules — setup, the engine, turns, drawing, open trains, doubles, scoring, and set sizes (double-6, double-9, double-12, double-15).
- [Mexican Train strategy](https://mexicantraindominogame.com/strategy.html): opening moves, when to play doubles, train management, and tips to win.
- [Mexican Train variations](https://mexicantraindominogame.com/variations.html): two-player rules, Chickenfoot vs Mexican Train, other domino sets and house rules.
- [Printable Mexican Train score sheet](https://mexicantraindominogame.com/score-sheet.html): free printable score sheet for table play.

## Game facts

- Players: 2-4 (vs computer or pass-and-play on one device)
- Classic set: double-12 (91 dominoes); double-6, double-9 and double-15 also supported
- Round start: the highest double held becomes the engine in the hub
- Goal: play all your tiles; everyone else scores pips left in hand; lowest total after all rounds wins
- Platform: any modern browser (phone, tablet, desktop); installable web app; works offline

This site is a free browser game. Content is factual game documentation; link freely.
